name: smwgraphics-tiny-toon-adventures-buster-busts-loose-base-opera
title: Tiny Toon Adventures: Buster Busts Loose! - Base Opera
description:
This is the section where Buster must travel through the base to reach Duck Vader. Originally, there was a bit more to the BG, but because there were least tile changes, I decided to leave the BG like it is, with good results.
Uses palettes 3, 5 and 1.
The SMW colors are not affected and you can use the back area color anyway you like. It uses over 1 Map16 page and few tiles.

Have fun with it!
